about: 회계1 2026-10-22: 외화장부(E010831) — 일반전표 줄 [외화] · [외화금액](V456) 저장 → 외화장부 거래처별집계 · 건별(이월/계) → 전표 지우면 빈 판. 분개장 [정렬/소계기준 설정] 창 '정렬/소계/합계 설정' — 계정명 기준 소계 표시 · 합계영역 표시안함. 계정등록 탭 셋 · [변경 ▴ 선택변경 · 표시순서변경] · [적요] '등록' → 적요리스트 · 적요등록 CRUD.

shots.name: 일반전표 외화 줄 → 외화장부
steps: js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const c = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')[0].querySelector('input.code'); c.focus(); set(c, '외상매출금'); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return true })()

js:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[aria-label="1줄 외화"]'); const o = [...s.options].find((x) => x.value); sessionStorage.setItem('fx-code', o.value); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, o.value); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return o.value })()

js:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[aria-label="2줄 구분"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, '4'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const c = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')[1].querySelector('input.code'); c.focus(); set(c, '제품매출'); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return true })()

expect:[...document.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map((t) => t.innerText.trim()).join('|').startsWith('일자-No.|적요|외화|원화') && [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].some((tr) => tr.innerText.includes('이월')) && [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].some((tr) => tr.innerText.includes('QA회계 외화') && tr.innerText.includes('100.00'))

js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const rows = (await (await fetch('/api/journals?from=' + day + '&to=' + day + '&all=true', { headers: H })).json()).rows.filter((e) => e.lines.some((l) => l.description === 'QA회계 외화')); for (const e of rows) await fetch('/api/journals/' + e.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return rows.length })()

shots.name: 분개장 정렬/소계/합계 설정
steps: expect:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return d.innerText.includes('정렬/소계/합계 설정') && ['올림', '내림', '선택삭제', '적용(F8)', '닫기'].every((t) => [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].some((b) => b.textContent.trim() === t)) && [...d.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map((t) => t.innerText.trim()).join('|').includes('순서|정렬/소계기준|정렬방법|페이지분할|소계/합계라인|상세설정') && d.innerText.includes('합계영역') && d.innerText.includes('소계/합계 표시항목') })()

js:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const tr = [...d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes('합계영역')); tr.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]')[1].click(); return true })()
